thread:
Marco Li: Heads-up 100000 - we need a compact launch asset pack for the webinar (assets for hero slide, three 1-card benchmarks, share & paid social, and a lead-routing mini-diagram). Goal: landing by Tue noon. Low-fi comps OK.

Jules (product-marketing): +1. Key asks: a single hero with two headline options for A/B, three metric cards (latency, cost, reliability), and a one-slide flow showing gated form -> segmentation -> CRM tags. Keep visuals tight; well reuse in email header.

Samira (demand-gen): Social sizes: IG square 1080x1080, LinkedIn 1200x627, Twitter card 1200x675. Also want a short 3-frame GIF (tile reveal) for paid. Can design supply motion layers?

Riley (design-ops): I can do comps. Timeline: initial PNGs + Figma frames in 36 hours. Motion layers in Figma as separate groups for potential GIF export. Need copy final and legal clearance on any price/latency calls.

Marco Li: Draft copy for cards (please refine):
- Latency: "p95 latency under ~25ms (typical)"
- Cost: "Unit cost: approximately $0.12/1k tokens (typical)"
- Reliability: "Uptime: 99.9% (target SLA)"
Hero headline variants:
A) "Lower inference spend, faster responses"
B) "Predictable latency for mission-critical features"
Landing: /webinar/inference-playbook/register (gated)
Segmentation rule: work_email && company_size >= 250 -> enterprise-path else inbound-path

Jules (product-marketing): For messaging, prefer "typical" language. Also need 1-line subheads for each card (25 characters max) for social overlays.

Legal Bot: Quick guidance: do not state guaranteed price or exact latency as promises. Use qualifiers like "typical", "up to", or "can help reduce". Include privacy blurb on gated form: "By registering you consent to communications from Redwood Inference. See https://redwood.com/privacy."

Riley (design-ops): Noted. Palette & type per brand kit: primary #0A74FF, accent #0B6FD8, neutral bg #F6F8FB. Headers: 600 weight, 22px; body 14px. Contrast min 4.5:1. Will provide dark-mode alternatives.

Evan (ops): For routing slide, map: gated -> work_email?yes -> CRM tag: webinar_enterprise OR webinar_inbound; queue notify: #leads-webinar (Slack) and ops@redwood.com. CSV export: columns: timestamp, email, company, company_size, route_tag. Keep PII handling note.

Samira (demand-gen): Paid ad variant needs muted background + white overlay copy. Also request a PNG hero (1920x1080) + Figma components for reuse. GIF should be max 2s loop.

Riley (design-ops): Plan: drop frames into Figma file /marketing/launch/compact-pack (link will go in comment). Deliverables: hero (1920x1080) x2 headline variants, 3 metric cards (1080x1080 & 1200x627), social-ready exports, routing-diagram slide (PPTX + PNG), optional GIF (2s). Accessibility: alt text file + EN/FR/DE translations for overlays.

Marco Li: Great. Owners: Riley = design; Jules = messaging; Samira = paid; Evan = routing/ops; Legal Bot = compliance. Ping here when Figma is up. :rocket:

Jules (product-marketing): I'll drop short subheads and localized copy within 12 hours.

Riley (design-ops): Dropping first-frame links now in Figma and commenting for legal. Will flag any copy over-length.

Legal Bot: I'll check Figma copy. Tag me in comments for a quick review.

Samira (demand-gen): Thanks 1000 - once we have assets, I'll QA in ad preview and confirm sizes.

Marco Li: Thanks team 100 - coordinate any blockers here.
